error[ZBX-E0820]: a fetch could not be downloaded
  while  downloading the .fetch of build step "fetch"
  cause  https://example.org/tool-1.2.tar.gz answered HTTP 404, not 200
  step   fetch
  url    https://example.org/tool-1.2.tar.gz
  fix    check the URL, or put the bytes in the store with an earlier build on a host that can reach it
  more   zbx explain E0820
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0820.html
